name: station_id
description: Unique NWIC monitoring borewell identifier

name: year_month
description: Calendar month in YYYY-MM format (2021-01 to 2025-12)

name: year
description: Four-digit calendar year (2021-2025)

name: month
description: Month of the year (1-12)

name: latitude
description: WGS84 decimal degrees latitude (11.5°N – 18.5°N)

name: longitude
description: WGS84 decimal degrees longitude (74.0°E – 78.5°E)

name: utm_x
description: Projected Easting coordinate in EPSG:32643 UTM Zone 43N (meters)

name: utm_y
description: Projected Northing coordinate in EPSG:32643 UTM Zone 43N (meters)

name: district
description: Karnataka administrative district (31 total districts)

name: basin
description: Major drainage basin (Krishna, Cauvery, Godavari, and West-Flowing Coastal River Basins)

name: cell_id
description: 25-km square spatial grid cell identifier in EPSG:32643

name: spatial_partition
description: Spatial split partition: train (64%), val (16%), or test (20%)

name: temporal_split
description: Chronological window: initial_fit, temporal_val, calibration, or test

name: is_core_cohort
description: True if well has >=70% valid monthly targets during 2021-2023

name: gwl_observed
description: 1 if observed telemetry reading exists (>=10 valid days); 0 if missing

name: depth_m_bgl
description: Primary Target: Groundwater depth below ground level in meters (monthly median)

name: n_valid_days
description: Count of days in the month with valid 6-hourly telemetry readings (>=10 required)

name: depth_std_m
description: Intra-month standard deviation of daily groundwater depths in meters

name: rainfall_mm
description: Monthly total rainfall interpolated from up to 5 nearest rain gauges via geodesic IDW

name: temp_c
description: Monthly mean air temperature interpolated from nearest climate stations via geodesic IDW

name: rain_cumul_3m_mm
description: Trailing 3-month cumulative rainfall total in millimeters

name: rain_cumul_6m_mm
description: Trailing 6-month cumulative rainfall total in millimeters

name: rain_cumul_12m_mm
description: Trailing 12-month cumulative rainfall total in millimeters

name: gwl_lag_1m
description: Observed groundwater level from preceding month t-1 (NaN if missing)

name: gwl_lag_2m
description: Observed groundwater level from 2 months prior t-2

name: gwl_lag_3m
description: Observed groundwater level from 3 months prior t-3

name: gwl_lag_6m
description: Observed groundwater level from 6 months prior t-6

name: gwl_lag_12m
description: Seasonal lag: observed groundwater level from 12 months prior t-12

name: gwl_delta_1m
description: 1-month depth rate of change: gwl_lag_1m - gwl_lag_2m

name: gwl_delta_3m
description: 3-month seasonal trend: gwl_lag_1m - gwl_lag_3m

name: month_sin
description: Seasonal harmonic encoding: sin(2 * pi * month / 12)

name: month_cos
description: Seasonal harmonic encoding: cos(2 * pi * month / 12)
